_provenance: Authored from Edison phase-1 + phase-2 deep-research outputs in research/media/. Dropped the Baumler 2007 'ATCC 49558' claim because the underlying citation (doi:10.1007/s00792-007-0108-8) is a Ferroplasma acidarmanus methanethiol paper, not Archaeoglobus — citation confusion. INSDC nucleotide accessions (CP002453, CP001393, CP000679) are not GCA/GCF/SAMN assembly accessions, so they are folded into evidence explanations rather than genome_assembly_id.

proposals.curation_note: Edison phase-2: Archaeoglobus fulgidus DSM 4304 grows on the parent DSM 399 medium; STL medium is a recognizable Archaeoglobus-type variant.

evidence.snippet: Cells of A. fulgidus DSM4304 (VC-16) were grown statically and anaerobically in 600 ml of DSM399 Archaeoglobus medium in a 1-L bottle with N2-CO2 (4:1) at 83C for 2 or 3 days.
evidence.explanation: Tarui et al. 2007 (J UOEH) explicitly grows the A. fulgidus type strain DSM 4304 in DSM399 Archaeoglobus medium, matching this parent record. Conditions: static anaerobic, N2-CO2 4:1, 83C, 2-3 d.

add_variants.name: stl_medium_archaeoglobus_variant
add_variants.description: STL (sulfate-thiosulfate-lactate) medium, a recognizable Archaeoglobus-type defined/complex medium used to grow A. fulgidus VC-16, distinct in formulation from the DSM 399 record.
modifications: Base built from a 10x salt solution (per L of 10x: NaCl 178 g, MgSO4 74 g, MgCl2.6H2O 27.5 g, KCl 3.4 g, NH4Cl 2.5 g; Salt II CaCl2.2H2O 1.4 g; Salt III K2HPO4 1.37 g) added at 100 ml/L.
PIPES buffer 20 ml of 1 M per L; base medium adjusted to pH 6.7 (Hartzell 1999). Reed 2001 variant uses Tris+maleic acid 20 mM each, pH 6.1.
Carbon/electron donor: sodium lactate 7 ml of 30% (w/v) per L (Hartzell 1999); DL-sodium lactate ~22 mM (Reed 2001).
Yeast extract 0.5 g/L (replaceable by Wolfe's vitamin mixture 10 ml/L for defined medium).
1000x trace element stock (1 ml/L) incl. Na2EDTA.2H2O, Mn/Co/Zn/Ni/Cu/B/Al/Mo/W/Se/V salts; (NH4)2Fe(SO4)2 1 ml of 0.2% per L.
Reductant: Na2S 100 mM + Na2S2O3 200 mM stock added at 0.5% v/v after autoclaving (Hartzell); Na2S/Na2S2O3 ~1 mM each (Reed).
Resazurin redox indicator; anaerobic, boiled and N2-sparged; good growth 75-82C (Hartzell), 83C in glass carboys (Reed).
add_variants.purpose: Capture the STL Archaeoglobus-type medium recipe used for A. fulgidus biofilm and enzyme studies as a variant of the DSM 399 parent rather than a duplicate medium.

evidence.snippet: A. fulgidus was grown in STL medium ... 10x salt solution 100 ml/L, PIPES buffer 20 ml of 1 M, trace element stock 1 ml of 1000x, yeast extract 0.5 g/L, sodium lactate 7 ml of 30% per L, pH 6.7; reducing agent Na2S 100 mM / Na2S2O3 200 mM added 0.5% v/v; good growth at 75-82C.
evidence.explanation: Hartzell et al. 1999 (Methods in Enzymology) prints the full STL medium recipe used to maintain A. fulgidus VC-16.

evidence.snippet: cells were grown anaerobically at 83C in glass carboys ... modified sulfate-thiosulfate-lactate (STL) medium 3 ... 20 mM Tris plus maleic acid, pH 6.1; DL-sodium lactate 22 mM; yeast extract 0.5 g/L; Na2S and Na2S2O3 1 mM; resazurin.
evidence.explanation: Reed et al. 2001 (J Bacteriol) reports a modified STL medium 3 for A. fulgidus, confirming the STL lineage and giving an alternate buffer/reductant variant.

proposals.curation_note: Edison phase-1/phase-2: multiple type strains grown directly on DSMZ medium 514 / Marine Broth 2216 (parent); MB1/2 half-strength is a concentration variant.

add_target_organisms.name: Cellulophaga algicola
add_target_organisms.other_identifiers: DSM 14237; CIP 107446; LMG 21425; INSDC CP002453; BioProject 41529; IMG 2503904003

evidence.snippet: C. algicola IC166T, DSM 14237, was grown in DSMZ medium 514 (BACTO marine broth) at 15C.
evidence.explanation: Abt et al. 2011 genome report; explicit type-strain growth on DSMZ medium 514 (= this parent medium) at 15C.

evidence.snippet: Colony morphology and temperature growth were determined on marine agar 2216 (Difco), and pH dependence was determined in marine broth 2216 (Difco). Colonies after 7 d at 30C; optimum 30-37C; pH optimum 7.0-8.0.
evidence.explanation: Han et al. 2009; direct cultivation/growth testing of the type strain on Marine Agar/Broth 2216 (= this parent medium family).

evidence.snippet: P. caeruleus DSM 24564T was grown in DSMZ medium 514. After incubation for 24 h in marine broth 2216 with shaking, visible growth was observed at 20C but not at 28C (100 rpm).
evidence.explanation: Beyersmann et al. 2013; explicit growth on DSMZ medium 514 / Marine Broth 2216 at 20C.

evidence.snippet: A single colony was passed for 2 days in Medium 514, explicitly identified as DSMZ Medium 514 Bacto Marine Broth Difco 2216, at 30C and 180 rpm.
evidence.explanation: Hollensteiner et al. 2020; medium identity explicitly aliased to this parent record; 30C, 180 rpm, 2 d.

evidence.snippet: J. marina strain En5T was isolated by dilution-plating on marine agar 2216 (Difco).
evidence.explanation: Stackebrandt et al. 2013; isolation on Marine Agar 2216 (recognizable 2216 formulation under this parent medium family). Agar isolation rather than broth growth.

evidence.snippet: MB1/2 defined as DSMZ medium 514 / Bacto Marine Broth Difco 2216 diluted to half strength with water; PRI 2902T grown on agar MB1/2 and in liquid MB1/2; colonies after 4 d at 70C.
evidence.explanation: Marteinsson et al. 2010; type strain grown on the half-strength MB1/2 variant of this parent medium (see variant mb_half_strength_marine_broth_2216). Deep-sea isolate; pressure tests at 0.1 and 25 MPa.

add_variants.name: mb_half_strength_marine_broth_2216
add_variants.description: MB1/2: DSMZ medium 514 / Bacto Marine Broth (Difco 2216) diluted to half strength with water, used for Rhodothermus profundi and related PRI isolates.
modifications: Marine broth/agar 2216 (DSMZ medium 514) diluted to 0.5x strength with water.
For single-carbon-source assays, peptone and yeast extract omitted from MB1/2 plates (assay variant, not routine MB1/2).
add_variants.purpose: Half-strength marine broth/agar 2216 used to cultivate slow-growing deep-sea Rhodothermus isolates; recognizable concentration variant, not a separate medium.

evidence.snippet: MB1/2 ... diluted to half strength with water; growth on single carbon sources tested on plates containing MB1/2 without peptone and yeast extract.
evidence.explanation: Marteinsson et al. 2010 defines MB1/2 explicitly as half-strength DSMZ 514 / Bacto Marine Broth 2216.

proposals.curation_note: Edison phase-1/phase-2: 8 Caldicellulosiruptor type strains + T. calidifontis Rx1 grown on MODIFIED DSMZ 640 (not the exact parent). NOTE: no source directly evidenced DSM 10319 itself on this medium.

evidence.snippet: Freeze-dried cells were resuspended in the recommended medium and subcultured ... into modified DSMZ medium 640 ... grown at 70C with orbital shaking; 50 ml in 125 ml serum bottle, N2 headspace, 24 h.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010; growth on the modified DSMZ 640 variant (see variant modified_dsmz_640_blumer_schuette_2010).

evidence.snippet: Subcultured into modified DSMZ 640; reported to grow on xylose, glucose, Avicel, pretreated switchgrass, and yeast extract control.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010; grown on modified DSMZ 640 variant; 70C, N2 headspace.

evidence.snippet: Subcultured into modified DSMZ 640 and included among seven species grown on selected substrates.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010; modified DSMZ 640 variant; 70C, N2 headspace.

evidence.snippet: Subcultured into modified DSMZ 640; explicitly noted to grow on xylose, to lower density than C. saccharolyticus.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010; modified DSMZ 640 variant; 70C, N2 headspace.

evidence.snippet: Subcultured into modified DSMZ 640 and included among seven species grown on selected substrates.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010; modified DSMZ 640 variant; 70C, N2 headspace.

evidence.snippet: Subcultured into modified DSMZ 640; explicitly reported as showing no growth on glucose in this comparison.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010; modified DSMZ 640 variant; 70C, N2 headspace. Note: no growth on glucose.

evidence.snippet: Subcultured into modified DSMZ 640 and included among seven species grown on selected substrates.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010; modified DSMZ 640 variant; 70C, N2 headspace.

evidence.snippet: Listed in Table 1 as available from DSMZ and stated in methods as among Caldicellulosiruptor species subcultured into modified DSMZ 640.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010; modified DSMZ 640 variant; substrate-specific growth not shown for this strain.

evidence.snippet: All culturing of Rx1 was performed in modified DSMZ medium 640, containing (per liter) 0.9 g NH4Cl, 0.9 g NaCl, 0.4 g MgCl2.6H2O, 0.75 g KH2PO4, 1.5 g K2HPO4, 2.5 mg FeCl3.6H2O, 0.75 g cysteine-HCl.H2O, 2 g tryptone, 1 g yeast extract, 1 ml SL-10, 0.5 mg resazurin, 5 ml vitamin solution, 10.0 g substrate; pH 7.0; prepared under 100% N2.
evidence.explanation: Shang et al. 2013; strain Rx1 grown on the modified DSMZ 640 variant (see variant modified_dsmz_640_shang_2013); full recipe printed; 55C, 100% N2.

add_variants.name: modified_dsmz_640_blumer_schuette_2010
add_variants.description: Modified DSMZ medium 640 used for comparative Caldicellulosiruptor physiology (Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010).
modifications: Trypticase, cysteine-HCl, and resazurin omitted relative to standard DSMZ 640.
Carbon source increased to 5 g/L; Na2S.9H2O added to 0.5% final.
Anaerobic batch cultivation under N2; 70C with orbital shaking; 50 ml in 125 ml serum bottle; 24 h.
add_variants.purpose: Reusable variant for the 8 Caldicellulosiruptor DSM strains grown in modified DSMZ 640 in this study.

evidence.snippet: subcultured ... into modified DSMZ medium 640 ... grown at 70C with orbital shaking under N2 headspace.
evidence.explanation: Blumer-Schuette et al. 2010 methods describe the modified DSMZ 640 formulation and cultivation.

add_variants.name: modified_dsmz_640_shang_2013
add_variants.description: Modified DSMZ medium 640 for Thermoanaerobacterium calidifontis Rx1 (Shang et al. 2013); ferric iron, added SL-10/vitamins/resazurin, variable substrate.
modifications: Iron source substituted: FeCl3.6H2O 2.5 mg/L (vs ferrous iron in parent).
Added trace element solution SL-10 (1 ml/L, DSMZ medium 320) and vitamin solution (5 ml/L, DSMZ medium 141, filter-sterilized).
Added resazurin 0.5 mg/L.
Fixed glucose replaced by variable substrate at 10.0 g/L (e.g. oat spelt xylan, xylose, glucose).

Per liter: 0.9 g NH4Cl, 0.9 g NaCl, 0.4 g MgCl2.6H2O, 0.75 g KH2PO4, 1.5 g K2HPO4, 0.75 g cysteine-HCl.H2O, 2 g tryptone, 1 g yeast extract; pH 7.0; prepared under 100% N2; dispensed 5 ml into 15 ml Hungate tubes; autoclaved.
add_variants.purpose: Capture the explicit modified DSMZ 640 recipe used to isolate and characterize T. calidifontis Rx1.

evidence.snippet: All culturing of Rx1 was performed in modified DSMZ medium 640, containing (per liter distilled water) 0.9 g NH4Cl, 0.9 g NaCl, 0.4 g MgCl2 x 6 H2O, 0.75 g KH2PO4, 1.5 g K2HPO4, 2.5 mg FeCl3 x 6 H2O, 0.75 g cysteine-HCl x H2O, 2 g tryptone, 1 g yeast extract, 1 ml trace element solution SL-10, 0.5 mg resazurin, 5 ml vitamin solution, 10.0 g substrate.
evidence.explanation: Shang et al. 2013 prints the full modified DSMZ 640 recipe with explicit deviations from the parent.

proposals.curation_note: Edison phase-2: Bacteroides ureolyticus ATCC 33387 is an exact parent match; ATCC 1490 base (without formate/fumarate) and carbonate/CO2-buffered ATCC 1490 are variants.

add_target_organisms.name: Bacteroides ureolyticus
add_target_organisms.other_identifiers: ATCC 33387; reclassified as Campylobacter ureolyticus (external to source)

evidence.snippet: Bacteroides ureolyticus ATCC 33387 was grown in ATCC medium 1490 with formate and fumarate. Each species was grown anaerobically without agitation at 37C for 24 or 48 hours.
evidence.explanation: O'Hanlon et al. 2011; EXACT parent-medium match (ATCC 1490 + formate + fumarate). Warning: B. ureolyticus has since been reclassified as Campylobacter ureolyticus, but that is external to this source.

evidence.snippet: Parabacteroides distasonis (ATCC 8503) was cultivated in ATCC 1490 Modified Chopped Meat medium at 37C anaerobically.
evidence.explanation: Kleniewska et al. 2023; grown on ATCC 1490 base (no formate/fumarate stated) -> see variant atcc_1490_base_no_formate_fumarate.

evidence.snippet: Fusobacterium nucleatum ATCC 25586 ... grown in ATCC medium 1490 (Modified chopped meat medium), anaerobically at 37C for 24 or 48 h.
evidence.explanation: O'Hanlon et al. 2011; ATCC 1490 base without formate/fumarate -> see variant atcc_1490_base_no_formate_fumarate.

evidence.snippet: Porphyromonas levii ATCC 29147 [was] grown in ATCC medium 1490 (Modified chopped meat medium), anaerobically at 37C for 24 or 48 h.
evidence.explanation: O'Hanlon et al. 2011; ATCC 1490 base without formate/fumarate -> see variant atcc_1490_base_no_formate_fumarate.

evidence.snippet: Prevotella bivia ATCC 29303 ... [was] grown in ATCC medium 1490 (Modified chopped meat medium), anaerobically at 37C for 24 or 48 h.
evidence.explanation: O'Hanlon et al. 2011; ATCC 1490 base without formate/fumarate -> see variant atcc_1490_base_no_formate_fumarate.

evidence.snippet: Lactobacillus crispatus ATCC 33820 was grown in ATCC medium 1490 (Modified chopped meat medium) anaerobically without agitation at 37C for 24 h.
evidence.explanation: O'Hanlon et al. 2011; ATCC 1490 base without formate/fumarate -> see variant atcc_1490_base_no_formate_fumarate.

evidence.snippet: Fusobacterium necrophorum (ATCC 27852) was grown in a modified chopped meat medium (ATCC 1490) buffered with carbonate/CO2; 38C, anaerobic glove bag, serum bottle technique.
evidence.explanation: Johnston et al. 2001; carbonate/CO2-buffered ATCC 1490 -> see variant atcc_1490_carbonate_co2_buffered.

add_variants.name: atcc_1490_base_no_formate_fumarate
add_variants.description: ATCC medium 1490 (Modified Chopped Meat medium) used WITHOUT the added formate and fumarate of the parent record.
modifications: Formate and fumarate omitted relative to the parent (ATCC 1490 + formate + fumarate).
Base ATCC 1490 Modified Chopped Meat medium; anaerobic, 37C, 24-48 h.
add_variants.purpose: Several BV-associated and gut anaerobes are reported on plain ATCC 1490 without the formate/fumarate supplement; model as the base variant rather than asserting growth on the formate+fumarate parent.

evidence.snippet: Fusobacterium nucleatum ATCC 25586 and Porphyromonas levii ATCC 29147 were all grown in ATCC medium 1490 (Modified chopped meat medium).
evidence.explanation: O'Hanlon et al. 2011 distinguishes the plain ATCC 1490 base from the formate+fumarate parent formulation.

add_variants.name: atcc_1490_carbonate_co2_buffered
add_variants.description: ATCC 1490 modified chopped meat medium buffered with carbonate/CO2 (Johnston et al. 2001).
modifications: Carbonate/CO2 buffering added to ATCC 1490 base (exact carbonate species/concentration and gas composition not printed).
For MIC assays, medium clarified through a 0.8 um filter (assay-use processing).
Anaerobic glove bag; serum bottle technique; 38C.
add_variants.purpose: Capture the carbonate/CO2-buffered ATCC 1490 variant used for Fusobacterium necrophorum growth and MIC assays.

evidence.snippet: Fusobacterium necrophorum (ATCC 27852) was grown in a modified chopped meat medium (ATCC 1490) buffered with carbonate/CO2. For MIC assays, this medium was clarified through a 0.8 um filter.
evidence.explanation: Johnston et al. 2001; ATCC 1490-derived variant with carbonate/CO2 buffering; no formate/fumarate, so distinct from the parent.

proposals.curation_note: Edison phase-2 (medium-confidence): Beijerinckia lactocogenes NTCC 38849 grown on a Becking medium variant at pH 5 without CaCO3.

evidence.snippet: the same medium without CaCO3 adjusted to pH 5 was used for culturing of Beijerinckia-type organisms; B. lactocogenes NTCC 38849 was one of the organisms used; soil cultures incubated 21 days at 30C.
evidence.explanation: Brierley & Thornton 1979; Beijerinckia-type organism grown on a Becking pH 5 no-CaCO3 variant (see variant becking_medium_ph5_no_caco3). Medium-confidence: strain-to-run linkage is at the organism-set level.

add_variants.name: becking_medium_ph5_no_caco3
add_variants.description: Becking medium variant for Beijerinckia-type organisms: CaCO3 omitted and pH adjusted to 5 (Brierley & Thornton 1979).
modifications: CaCO3 omitted relative to standard Becking medium.
pH adjusted to 5 (vs near-neutral parent).
Base recipe context: glucose 20 g/L, KH2PO4 1.0 g/L, MgSO4.7H2O 0.5 g/L (CaCO3 2.0 g/L before omission); soil cultures 21 d at 30C.
add_variants.purpose: Capture the acid, CaCO3-free Becking variant used for culturing Beijerinckia-type organisms.

evidence.snippet: the same medium without CaCO3 adjusted to pH 5 was used for culturing of Beijerinckia-type organisms.
evidence.explanation: Brierley & Thornton 1979; explicit formulation change (no CaCO3, pH 5) for Beijerinckia culturing.
